item.description: Agentic reinforcement learning (RL) and multi-teacher on-policy distillation (MOPD) offer complementary routes to post-training. item.title: LongSCOP: Semantically Consistent Long Video Outpainting
item.description: Video out-painting is an important problem, yet existing research focuses primarily on short clips, leaving long video out-painting largely underexplored. A natural solution is iterative out-painting, i.e., generating videos chunk by chunk, but this introduces two major issues: generation instability or even failure caused by inter-chunk inconsistencies and error accumulation, and semantic drift over long temporal horizons. item.description: Anomaly detection (AD) is a critical for trustworthy machine learning and scientific discovery. item.description: As large language models become more capable agents, they can exhibit deceptive behaviors, cheating human for higher rewards while appearing helpful.
